seeds.text: When I argue with reality, I lose — but only 100% of the time. Acceptance isn't surrender. It's stopping a war you can't win.
Your inner critic learned its voice from someone else. That's why it doesn't sound like yours — and why it doesn't sound like love.
The trance of unworthiness is the most painful story most people live inside. The trance, not the truth.
You can't skip the grief. Only through. Anything you go around stays exactly where it is.
Until you make the unconscious conscious, it directs your life — and you'll call it destiny instead of pattern.

slides.composition: A large, ornate chrome keyhole, slightly off-center, through which a blurry, distressed face is vaguely visible, conveying a sense of hidden internal struggle.

slides.text: That sharp inner critic? It learned its lines from someone else's pain.
slides.composition: A shimmering, cracked metallic egg, viewed from a close-up, with subtle light emanating from the jagged fissures, suggesting inherited fragility.

slides.text: This isn't your own voice. It's an echo you've carried, mistaking it for truth.
slides.composition: A solitary, ancient-looking chrome bell, slightly tarnished, seen from a low angle, its faint ringing ripples distorting the surrounding air.

slides.text: You aren't unworthy. You're just living inside the *trance* of unworthiness.
slides.composition: A shimmering, almost invisible thread, illuminated by a distant glow, delicately entangling a small, suspended abstract metallic figure, conveying quiet entrapment.

slides.text: This trance is a story, not the truth of you. It's painful because it's a lie.
slides.composition: A fractured, glowing crystal sphere, close-up and off-kilter, reflecting distorted, fragmented images, emphasizing a painful, broken perception.

slides.text: Your job: gently notice the pattern when it shows up. Let it be seen.
slides.composition: A pair of ethereal, stylized chrome hands, palms open and cradling a soft, diffused light, framed from a medium distance, offering gentle observation.

slides.text: You don't have to argue with an echo anymore.
slides.composition: A vast, serene cosmic field with a single, clear, shining star in the distance, framed by a soft, ethereal arch, suggesting peace and clarity.

caption:
That voice in your head, the one that makes you feel small? It’s not actually yours. You picked it up. You can notice it now, and just let it be. It doesn't have to run the show.
